name: @knowget/campus-security
description: Campus Security, Safety & Visitor Platform (P2-D21) — the institution's security-operations system of record: the visitors and their visits, the access-controlled zones, the credentials that open them and the immutable access-decision log, the security incidents raised on campus, and the emergency drills conducted, with a descriptive per-zone safety profile. A pure presence engine derives who is on-site (checked-in visits, rolled zone → campus) and reconciles a drill's expected roster against the accounted-for muster into the safety-critical unaccounted-for count; a pure access engine decides a credential's access to a zone. The standing safeguarding/disciplinary record is Learner Wellbeing's (P2-D05) and clinical incidents are the Health Centre's (P2-D19); money (security-service billing/procurement) is out of scope, and domain events carry no money.
